spots.name: Ver-o-peso
spots.summary: The Ver-o-Peso Market, Mercado Municipal Bolonha de Peixe, Mercado de Ferro, or Ver-o-Peso is a street market and fair, and small port area inaugurated in 1901 that is part of the Ver-o-Peso Complex (1625).

spots.name: Forte do Presépio

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: Forte do Presépio is a fort located in Belém, Pará, Brazil. It was built in 1616 by Francisco Caldeira Castelo Branco at Maúri Point, a promontory on the right bank of the mouth of the Guamá River and Guajará Bay. The first chapel in Belém was located in the fort.

spots.name: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Our Lady of Grace Cathedral also called Catedral Nossa Senhora de Belém. It is the seat of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Belém do Pará and is located in the old quarter of the city in Belém in Brazil.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Belém

photo.author: Celso Roberto de Abreu Silva from Belém, Brasil

spots.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Nazareth of Exile

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Basilica of Our Lady of Nazareth of Exile is a minor basilica of the Catholic Church located in the city of Belém, Pará, Brazil. Its construction started in 1909 at the place where the image of the Virgin of Nazareth was found by Plácido José de Souza in the state of Pará, on the banks of the Murututu Igarapé.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Basilica of Our Lady of Nazareth of Exile

spots.name: Theatro da Paz
spots.summary: Theatro da Paz is a theater located in the Praça da República on the city of Belém, capital of the state of Pará, in Brazil. It was built following neoclassical architectural lines during the golden age of rubber in Amazon Basin. It is considered the most important culture house in northern Brazil.

photo.author: Celso Roberto de Abreu Silva from Belém, Brasil

spots.name: Rodrigues Alves Park

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Rodrigues Alves Park and Botanical Garden of Amazonia, or simply Rodrigues Alves Park is a Brazilian environmental preservation area located in the Marco neighborhood, in the city of Belém, the capital of the state of Pará.

spots.name: Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: The Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, commonly shortened MPEG, is a Brazilian research institution and museum located in the city of Belém, state of Pará, Brazil.

spots.name: Palace of the Eleven Windows

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The House of the Eleven Windows Cultural Space, initially called Palace of the Eleven Windows, is a complex composed of a public square and a historical building located in the Brazilian city of Belém, in Pará.

spots.name: Feliz Lusitânia
spots.summary: Feliz Lusitânia, now known as Conjunto Arquitetônico e Paisagístico Feliz Lusitânia or Complexo Turístico Feliz Lusitânia, was a Portuguese colonial settlement created in 1616 by Captain Francisco Caldeira Castelo Branco in the then Conquista do Pará, at the time of the overseas province of Colonial Brazil, originating the Pará municipality of Belém.

spots.name: Antônio Lemos Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Palácio Antônio Lemos, also called the Belém Art Museum, is a public building, palace, museum, and the city hall of Belém, built in 1860 by José da Gama Abreu, in the context of the rubber cycle. It is located in the Cidade Velha neighborhood.

spots.name: Church and Former College of Saint Alexander

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

photo.author: Celso Roberto de Abreu Silva from Belém, Brasil

spots.name: Lauro Sodré Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Lauro Sodré Palace, also called Government Palace, and initially called Residence House, is a public building, palace, museum and seat of the state government, built in 1680 and located in the neighborhood of Cidade Velha, in the Brazilian city of Belém, in the state of Pará.

spots.name: Estação das Docas

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Estação das Docas is a Brazilian tourist-cultural complex and multi-environmental space created in 2000. It is located in the Campina neighborhood, in Belém, the capital of Pará, and was originally built as part of the city's port. It is currently managed by the Pará 2000 Social Organization.

spots.name: Cine Olympia
spots.summary: The Cine Olympia, currently known as the Cine Olympia Municipal Space, is a movie theater that inaugurated in 1912 in the Campina district, in the Brazilian municipality of Belém, capital of the state of Pará.

spots.name: Museu de Arte Sacra do Pará

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Bolonha Mansion
spots.summary: The Bolonha Mansion is a historic residence in Belém, Pará, Brazil. It was built between 1905 and 1908 by the architect Francisco Bolonha (1872–1939) as a gift to his wife Alice Tem-Brink; he is also noted as the father of the modernist architect Francisco de Paula Lemos Bolonha.

photo.author: Celso Roberto de Abreu Silva from Belém, Brasil

spots.name: Praça do Relógio
spots.summary: The Siqueira Campos Square or Clock Square is a public space located at the Ver-o-Peso Dock, in the Cidade Velha neighborhood, in the Brazilian city of Belém, capital of Pará.

spots.name: Belém Museum of Art

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Belém Museum of Art (MABE) is a public municipal museum located in the city of Belém, capital of the state of Pará, Brazil. Founded in 1991, it is subordinated to the Cultural Foundation of the Municipality of Belém (FUMBEL).

spots.name: Our Lady of Solitude Cemetery
spots.summary: Our Lady of Solitude Cemetery is a former cemetery and, nowadays, an urban park in Brazil, originally established as a public necropolis in 1850 by Captain Joaquim Vitorino de Sousa Cabral in the Batista Campos neighborhood of Belém, Pará.

spots.name: Parque Zoobotânico do Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi
Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel is a Catholic church located in the historic center of Belém. The current building dates back to the 18th century and was designed by several architects, including Antônio Landi.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel (Belém)

spots.name: Dom Frei Caetano Brandão Square
spots.summary: The Dom Frei Caetano Brandão Square, originally called Largo da Sé, is located in the Cidade Velha neighborhood in the Brazilian city of Belém, capital of the state of Pará.

spots.name: Cidade Velha
spots.summary: Cidade Velha, initially called Mairi, Cidade or Sé neighborhood, is a historic area of the capital of Pará, Belém, founded in the 1620s.

spots.name: São Brás Market
spots.summary: The São Brás Market is a historic building located in the Brazilian city of Belém, in the state of Pará. It was built during the Amazon rubber cycle. Construction began on May 1, 1910, and was completed on May 21, 1911.

spots.name: Ver-o-Rio
spots.summary: Ver-o-Rio is a tourist complex located in a 5,000-square-meter (54,000 sq ft) Brazilian public square inaugurated in 1999 in the city of Belém (Pará). It is on the shores of Guajará Bay in the Umarizal neighborhood and next to the Center of Social Sciences and Education of the State University of Pará (UEPA).

spots.name: Boulevard Castilhos França
spots.summary: Boulevard Castilhos França, originally called Rua Nova do Imperador and Boulevard da República, is a street located in the Campina neighborhood, on the shores of Guajará Bay, in the Brazilian city of Belém, capital of the state of Pará. Created in 1848, it is one of Belém's first wide thoroughfares.

spots.name: Bibi Costa Mansion
spots.summary: The Bibi Costa Mansion, also known as José Júlio de Andrade Mansion, or simply O Castelinho, is a historic residence in Belém, Pará, Brazil.

spots.name: Utinga State Park
spots.summary: The Utinga State Park is a state park within the metropolitan area of Belém, Pará, Brazil. It is surrounded by the Metropolitan Belém Environmental Protection Area, which protects a large part of the water supply of the city.

spots.name: Solar da Beira
spots.summary: Solar da Beira is a public building designed in the neoclassical architectural style that integrates the Ver-o-Peso Complex. It is located in the Brazilian city of Belém, Pará, in the Cidade Velha neighborhood, on the shores of Guajará Bay.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of Saint John the Baptist, also known as the Igreja de São Joãozinho, is a colonial temple located in Líbano Square, also known as Largo de São João, in the city of Belém, in the Brazilian state of Pará.

spots.name: Meat Market, Belém
spots.summary: The Francisco Bolonha Municipal Meat Market, Bolonha Market or simply Meat Market, is a structure built in 1867 that belongs to the Ver-o-Peso Complex. It is located in the Brazilian city of Belém, capital of Pará, on Boulevard Castilhos França, in the neighborhood of Campina.

spots.name: Pará State Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Pará State Museum, officially the Pará State Historical Museum, or MHEP, is a Brazilian government institute created in 1981 and currently housed in the Lauro Sodré Palace, in the Cidade Velha district of Belém.

spots.name: Pinho Mansion
spots.summary: Pinho Mansion is a historic building located at 586 Doutor Assis Street in the Cidade Velha district, in Belém, the capital of the state of Pará. In 1986, it was listed as a national heritage site by the National Institute of Historic and Artistic Heritage (IPHAN) for its importance in the city.

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Ver-o-Peso Dock is an open-air municipal public fish market and a small port area that belongs to the Ver-o-Peso Complex, located on the shores of Guajará Bay in the Cidade Velha neighborhood, in the city of Belém, the capital of Pará, Brazil.

Convent of the Mercedarians

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Convent of the Mercedarians is a historic building located in the Brazilian city of Belém, Pará. It is part of the architectural complex that includes the Mercedarian Convent and the Church of Our Lady Mercy.

spots.name: Solar Barão de Guajará
spots.summary: Solar Barão de Guajará, also known as Casa à Praça Pedro II, is a manor house located in Belém, the capital of the state of Pará, Brazil, more specifically in the Dona Tomázia Perdigão Street. It was built in the 19th century and has three floors, the last of which is smaller.

spots.name: Augusto Montenegro Mansion
spots.summary: The Augusto Montenegro Mansion, also known as the Montenegro Mansion, is a historic residence in Belém, Pará, Brazil. It was completed in 1903 for Governor Augusto Montenegro (1867-1915). It is one of numerous structures built in Belém in the eclecticism during the Amazonian "rubber cycle" in the early 20th century.

spots.name: Estádio da Curuzu
spots.summary: Estádio Leônidas Sodré de Castro, also known as Estádio Leônidas Castro, but usually known as Estádio da Curuzu, is a football stadium owned by Paysandu Sport Club, located in São Braz neighborhood, Belém, Pará, Brazil. The stadium has a maximum capacity of 16,200 people.
